title: Leading Change: Collaborating for a better future in Vietnam
author: Stephanie
body:
Who are the Blue Dragon Children’s Foundation?

There is a good chance that you haven’t heard of Blue Dragon yet, but since their small beginnings in 2003, Blue Dragon has become a powerful force for change on the streets of Vietnam, both in bustling cities and in rural areas where poverty is widespread. A huge percentage of Vietnamese children are born into poverty; rice farming is a major industry and sadly it is not unusual for whole families to earn $1 - $2 a day. Due to these difficult conditions, children often have to leave school and move out of their homes, making them vulnerable to homelessness, sexual exploitation and human trafficking.

Blue Dragon offers a holistic range of services to address the issues created by poverty in Vietnam, including shelter, legal advocacy, and long-term support to return to school and training. Blue Dragon also works tirelessly to find and rescue children from the trafficking trade, sometimes having to travel to countries across Asia to bring the children safely back to Vietnam.

Help from OneTomorrow

OneTomorrow is a charitable fund established by the APT Travel Group in 2019, to help create a positive, enduring impact on the nature and communities we touch in our travels across the globe. OneTomorrow are proud to support the Blue Dragon Children’s Foundation with the help of our guests and employees. Our funding includes the specific sponsorship of five children, Nhu, Tien, Sang, Hoi, and Ha, so they continue to stay in school, access higher education and hopefully lift themselves and their families out of poverty. The oldest student OneTomorrow currently sponsors, Nhu is just one example of the incredible impact Blue Dragon has for young people. At age 15, she is excelling in Maths and Literature and aspires to become a psychologist and support her Mum and little sister, a stark contrast from what her life would have looked like had she been forced to leave school to work. With OneTomorrow’s continued support, even more children can experience the joy and security of education, with all costs covered.
